title: Almost Television: Episode 1 - we built an agentic AI production studio, and its crew made a sketch comedy show!
author: Slackluster
selftext:
Not a video generator: a full production pipeline where AI agents fill every role, and the result is rendered in real-time 3D with a custom three.js pipeline.

https://i.redd.it/24ca876ssouh1.gif

* **Writers' room:** agents pitch and draft sketches; AI test viewers rank them and give notes.

https://i.redd.it/actng0xqsouh1.gif

* **Casting:** every puppet auditions for its voice.
* **Art department:** sets, props and costumes built from a shared library of 3D felt pieces, reused every episode.
* **Directing:** a camera style per sketch, and automatic review of every shot for framing, eyelines and continuity**.**

https://i.redd.it/4i9019lxsouh1.gif

* **Post:** captions, edit and a final render with ray-traced shadows.

An episode is a script; the crew stages, shoots and renders it. I'm the showrunner.

# Full episode: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B\_BITUp8qig](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B_BITUp8qig)
